text: 1. Scanned copy of valid passport’s information page;2. Scanned copy of Highest Academic Degree Certificate, Expected Graduation Certificate for fresh graduates(original one and English-translated one. After being pre-admitted, applicants are required to submit final Graduation Certificate to be eligible for official admission.);3. Scanned copiesof transcript of all courses during the highest academic degree education (original one and English-translated one);4. ID photo (2-inch blue background photo without hats);5. Scanned copyofForeigner’s Physical Examination Formcompleted in Chinese or English;6. English self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M);7. Certificate of Language proficiency;8.Financial Support Guarantee Statementand scanned copies of its supporting documentscompleted in Chinese or English, certifying that the applicant has sufficient funds to cover his or her tuition, accommodation, living expenses and international travels during his or her study in China. The minimum amount of funding required is RMB 150,000. Only one’s relatives can act as his or her financial sponsor. The statement should be accompanied by a scanned copy of the financial sponsor’s valid passport or identification certificate(self-supporting applicants should submit this statement);9. Original Authorization to the Guardian (for self-supporting applicants under the age of 18 by September 1, 2025) needs to be notarized with signatures. If not notarized in China, the endorsement of local Chinese Embassy is required.★ Guardians shall be Chinese or foreign adults who reside in China with stable source of income.★ Graduation certificateand transcriptshould be notarized.★The University will request for supplementary materials when necessary.★ Application materials mentioned above will not be returned to applicants whether they are admitted or not.★All the forms can be downloaded from the official website of School of International Education.
